original_closure_conditions: 定义 local qualification 与 executable authority 的不同字段
若 G1 已通过，绑定 exact G1 GateResultReceipt 并统一重生成 Manifest/Registry/README/trace
若未通过，撤销 authoritative 表述并继续以 v3.3 为 pre-G1 authority
采用 typed VersionVector
为每个轴记录 current/superseded/compatible-with/digest
任何 Gate/Status/Release Receipt 绑定完整适用向量而非单一 VERSION
冻结 exact required check set
配置 branch/rules protection 或等价外部不可变 Gate Receipt
采用签名 tag/attestation 或透明签名制品
清理 merged duplicate branch with receipt
单独研究并形成通用候选合同
定义角色、职责、状态、Artifact identity、Human Approval、Publish Gate、Production Verification、Rollback、Receipt/Evidence
明确网站流程只是一个 domain projection
在目标结构中把 User Bundle consumer snapshot 与 source/development control 分离
根 Authority Router 默认 NONE，不把用户数据当开发状态
敏感 owner/account refs 使用 endpoint policy，不进入可扩散审计/公共包
对现存历史做 access and leakage review
冻结 ArtifactIdentity、ReleaseUnitIdentity、EditionIdentity、SKU/Offer/Entitlement typed refs
声明 technical qualification, distribution, commercial availability and user entitlement are separate states
Product/Store only project current Kernel/Registry facts
以 current Commit/Tree 做实测输入
Architecture v1.0 只冻结责任，不先锁死目录
Structure Plan 生成唯一 FrozenTargetMap 和 CurrentToTargetMap
旧 v3.3 target 每项标记 inherited/changed/retired
冻结 Phase2 MVP success metric and maximum active workstreams
只把 Slice A 放核心关键路径
Model M1-M7、Commerce、Marketplace、大规模训练均单独预算和 GO/NO-GO
每个阶段必须交付可运行纵向 E2E，不接受仅 Schema/Receipt 堆积
